adaptation_notes: The build fragment calls find_package(Jolt CONFIG REQUIRED), links Jolt::Jolt, and compiles glue that derives from Jolt classes with -fno-rtti (MSVC /GR-).

Setup glue runs Factory and RegisterTypes, then creates one PhysicsSystem with two object layers (non-moving, moving) mapped to two broad-phase layers, a TempAllocatorImpl, and the jobs adapter from the jolt--jobs binding.
The layer tables are placeholders the game replaces; setup glue creates no bodies.
Shutdown destroys the PhysicsSystem before UnregisterTypes and deleting the Factory.
